name: American Honda - Troy Parts Distribution Center - Troy OH

fieldNotes.siteIdentity: American Honda's Troy Parts Distribution Center (PDC) — a 534,000 sq ft parts DC operating in Troy since 1986. It is the northern of two adjacent large Honda warehouses off Commerce Center Blvd; the southern building is the 2007 Midwest Consolidation Center (MCC, roster idx 16, at 151 Commerce Center Blvd). The roster idx-15 geocode landed in a residential area; the facility was re-located via satellite and web research. Building center locked at ~40.0485, -84.2372. The PDC/MCC assignment (PDC = north building) follows from the MCC roster coordinates pointing to the southern building and the MCC being described as built adjacent to the older PDC.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The PDC campus is fenced with a controlled entrance — a Honda monument sign and flag at the entry road off the public road, and a small guard-booth-footprint structure beside the internal access road. Classified true (medium confidence — no Street View inside the gate to confirm a barrier arm).
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small building consistent with a staffed guard booth sits beside the entrance access road. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — a guard-booth structure appears present.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: A large paved staging/parking lot sits between the public road and the building, usable for truck holding.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Ample paved internal aprons and lanes between the gate and the dock banks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: A long internal access road runs from the entrance through the campus to the docks — easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ dock doors estimated across the north and east building faces, with many trailers backed in. Honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop yards on the west and east sides holding well over 50 Honda trailers (visible in dense colored rows) without tractors.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Multiple dedicated trailer-storage lots, clearly separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: The PDC sits in a two-building Honda campus with the adjacent MCC; counted as a multi-facility campus, though the PDC itself is a single building.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Large empty paved staging lots and wide aprons leave clear room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity appears consolidated on the north/east faces; not clearly split into separate ship vs receive clusters — left false.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural — edge-of-town setting along the I-75 corridor with farmland to the west and a water tower nearby; small-town industrial, so classified Rural.
